sources.name: JRA Horse Racing Dataset by takamotoki

sources.name: KBlueLeaf/jp-racing-horse
sources.provenance: Dataset card contains only the license declaration and does not identify the original data source or collection method.
sources.reason: A repository license alone does not establish provenance or permission for the database contents.

sources.name: 地方競馬情報サイト データダウンロード
